title: AI at the Mortgage Point of Sale: Intake That Starts the TRID Clock Without Starting a Violation
summary: How to put an AI agent in front of the borrower application without mishandling the six-piece application trigger, the three-day Loan Estimate deadline, or the Reg B adverse action clock. A use-case playbook for digital lending teams.
